responsibility: This file provides the AArch64 implementation of the GCC D front end’s target hooks. It registers the D predefined target versions that identify AArch64 and hard-float operation, and supplies target-info query handlers such as __traits(getTargetInfo, "floatAbi") by returning AArch64-specific answers to the D front end.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file in the aarch64-d pair: it contains the actual D front-end hook bodies that register AArch64 target versions and answer target-info queries, whereas aarch64-d.h only declares those hooks and maps them to TARGET_D_* macros.
